meta.title: Terms
meta.description: General terms and conditions of Moritz Hecht – Invessiv.

page.title: General Terms and Conditions
page.lead: These terms apply to services by Moritz Hecht – Invessiv related to website creation, website optimization, digital process solutions, and AI-assisted workflow templates.

scope.title: 2. Scope
scope.body: These terms apply to all offers, services, and contracts between Moritz Hecht – Invessiv and business customers unless otherwise agreed in writing. Information submitted through the project request is used for pre-contractual evaluation and offer preparation.

services.title: 3. Services
services.body: Type and scope of services are defined by offer, scope description, and project briefing. Timeframes shown on the website (for example 2–5 days or 7–14 days) are typical estimates and not guaranteed deadlines. Scope changes require separate agreement. To accelerate research, structuring, and draft phases, AI tools may be used as support. Domain review, implementation, and final quality assurance are carried out by the provider.

payment.title: 4. Payment terms
payment.body: Prices follow the individual offer. Package prices and hourly rates listed on the website (development/implementation: €70–85 / h, content/small updates: €50–60 / h) are indicative and finalized per project. Invoices are due within 14 days without deductions.

usageRights.title: 5. Usage rights
usageRights.body: Upon full payment, the client receives the agreed usage rights for delivered results within the contractually defined scope.
